steps.en: Life status data arrives every day from the ICA/DOS interface
steps.id: Data life status masuk setiap hari dari interface ICA/DOS
steps.why_en: Data comes from the MHA file, not ICA/DOS, and not on Sundays.
steps.why_id: Data datang dari file MHA, bukan ICA/DOS, dan tidak berjalan hari Minggu.

steps.en: Life status and date of death are checked and saved on the offender record
steps.id: Life status dan tanggal meninggal dicek lalu disimpan pada record offender

steps.en: The system identifies notices issued to individuals with a given life status
steps.id: OCMS mengenali notice milik individu dengan life status tertentu
steps.why_en: Only notices sent in the enquiry file are checked, not all notices.
steps.why_id: Hanya notice yang dikirim di file enquiry yang dicek, bukan semua notice.

steps.en: The system suspends those notices immediately, with no manual step
steps.id: OCMS langsung menangguhkan notice itu tanpa langkah manual
steps.why_en: Suspension runs in the same job, but paid or already-suspended notices can be rejected.
steps.why_id: Penangguhan jalan di job yang sama, tetapi notice yang sudah dibayar atau ditangguhkan bisa ditolak.

steps.en: The suspension is temporary, with a specific code and period
steps.id: Penangguhan bersifat sementara, dengan kode dan periode tertentu
steps.why_en: The notices are suspended permanently, not temporarily, and there is no period.
steps.why_id: Notice ditangguhkan permanen, bukan sementara, dan tidak ada periode.

steps.en: For FIN holders, life status also comes from DataHive and notices are suspended
steps.id: Untuk pemegang FIN, life status juga dibaca dari DataHive dan notice ditangguhkan
steps.why_en: This job exists but is switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Job ini ada tetapi dimatikan di pengaturan production.
